content.text:
This looks good — Home, About, and Contact are now equally-sized sections, so the scrollspy will correctly highlight whichever one is in view instead of always favoring Home.

Summary of the fix: the "Home" nav link pointed at `#main` (the whole `<main>` element), so the IntersectionObserver treated it as perpetually visible and the active-link logic never correctly settled on About/Contact. Wrapped the intro content in its own `#home` section and cleaned up the redundant `aria-current` toggling logic to a plain set/remove.
